knowledge_graph.title: Vandegrift High School
knowledge_graph.description: Vandegrift High School is a public high school in Austin, Texas. It educates students in grades 9-12 for the Leander Independent School District. The school received an overall rating of "A" from the Texas Education Agency for the 2024-2025 school year.
